title: evalsig gate conditions (gate.toml as JSON, gate/1)
description: Drafted by an agent or a person with preregister --draft; only conditions a person approves with preregister approve, with the referee's authority, take effect. Approval resolves every setting not given here, pins names (the baseline run, the split) to hashes and writes approved/<hash>.toml; gate reads only that copy and never the project's config.toml.

hypothesis.description: What should improve, in one to three sentences

baseline.description: The baseline run_id; approval pins it to its snapshot hash. Without it the gate judges absolute criteria only

candidate.description: A run_id, or * for the candidate the agent submits when the gate runs

grader.description: The grader the candidate must use; gate stops when run.grader differs. This stops mix-ups, not a grader that was altered

positive.description: Which reference label values count as positive (the configuration's rule syntax; boolean is accepted as equals). Required for decision runs whose metrics read the reference; approval resolves it

decision.description: From which judgment value the system counts as saying positive. Required for H and F of score outputs

estimand.description: The performance of one production run (single_shot) or of a rule over k runs (majority@k, any@k, all@k); metrics spec §6.1

replicates.description: Generation replicates the candidate must have. Replicates whose outputs are all identical stop the gate; selecting replicates cannot be detected

missing.description: Handling per missing reason (metrics spec §0.1). Applies to validation only; on the holdout every missing value is the worst

min_items.description: Paired items (a count independent of the reference labels). With fewer, the gate does not decide and reports insufficient data. Approval checks it against the holdout's size

conditions.description: Pass when all hold (an intersection-union test; no per-condition correction). The first is the Ladder's primary condition

rule.description: pass applies only to verdict metrics such as human_parity

min_effect.description: The smallest difference that matters: a delta rule does not pass when the point difference is below it

level.description: The level before division by the budget B; each submission is judged at 1 - (1 - level)/B

interval.description: auto chooses by metrics spec §1.1. This version accepts auto only; a draft naming another method is refused

source.description: Whose judgments win_rate and kappa_vs_reference use

budget.description: Submissions B allowed on the holdout; each is judged at alpha/B (Bonferroni). The budget accumulates per sealed holdout in the referee ledger and survives re-approval

ladder_k.description: The k of the step eta = k * sqrt(psi / n), n being the primary condition's denominator; the referee fixes eta at approval (metrics spec §11.3)

ladder_step.description: Only to choose eta yourself; approval refuses a value below the automatic one

reference.description: How the reference is built and the rater design (metrics spec §9.2-9.3)

mode.description: Unset: soft for items with two or more human raters, single for one. latent needs three or more raters per item

rater_design.description: The rater design; auto detects it from the rater-item overlap. Raters are not resampled

resolved.description: Written by the referee at approval, never in a draft; appears only in approved/<hash>.toml

holdout_items_hash.description: Hash of the holdout items' IDs and attributes (weight, cluster, strata, label_inclusion_prob, input_ref)

mapping_hash.description: The hash of the mapping or converter, pinned at approval

mapping.description: The mapping file (mapping.toml) or converter script that makes the candidate's records; approval pins its hash and gate refuses candidates made otherwise
